policy: Union the referenced inventory, every function in production_files, and every added or modified production function since baseline, including untracked Go files.
Include all new CLI command constructors, handlers and helpers and modified registration/shared functions regardless of filename. Never restrict discovery to a correction filename.
Removed functions require explicit scope review; missing files or symbols fail. Derive the denominator from source instrumentation, never the profile.
Missing profile blocks count as zero covered statements with their full source statement count. Missing/empty profiles cannot pass.
No exclusion solely to raise coverage; no partial function ranges, generated test-only copies, package aggregate substitute or threshold reduction.
Use native Go test JSON run and pass events for every case and subcase; absent, skipped or failed cases prevent repair completion.
Run mutants with source overlays; require the named assertion failure, not a compilation or infrastructure failure, and verify source hashes after cleanup.
